name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

Dive into the world of logistics with 'Auf Achse' and unleash your talent as a logistics expert – where strategy, planning, and a bit of luck decide your success. Download now and start your journey as a transport mogul!

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

name: BoardGameGeek
description:
This is the official app for BoardGameGeek, an online resource and community that aims to be the definitive source for board game and card game content. Daily new content, continuously updated by millions of passionate users, makes ‘the Geek’ the largest and most up-to-date place to get gaming information. You can become a registered member of BoardGameGeek (BGG) for free, and we welcome your contributions in the form of ratings, reviews, and thoughts on games!

BGG features reviews, ratings, images, play-aids, translations, and session reports from board game geeks around the world, as well as live discussion forums.

Here you’ll find many types of board games, including thousands you’ve probably never seen in a store. We cover not only board games but also dice games, card games, tile-laying games, and games of dexterity. We have abstracts, economic games, dungeon crawls, city building, diplomacy and negotiation, trading, puzzle games, strategy games, party games, war games, and many more. We run the gamut from the light and whimsical Carcassonne to the serious and heavy empire-building of Twilight Imperium: Fourth Edition. Well-known games like Monopoly exist in the database as well, although you’ll find almost all users prefer modern games that exhibit advancements in game play and component quality since Monopoly was first published.

Ad-blocking subscription
When you purchase ‘AdBlock for Android’ you enjoy an ads-free experience in the app (except for embedded web views). Payment will be charged on a recurring monthly or annual basis. Your monthly or annual AdBlock subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription ends. Cancel anytime in your device’s Account Settings. No partial refunds.

name: RISK: Global Domination
description:

Step into a world where every decision can change the fate of nations. RISK: Global Domination is the official digital version of the classic Hasbro board game that has captivated millions of players for generations. A true test of wartime strategy, negotiation, and domination.

ENGAGE IN MULTIPLAYER TURN BASED WAR GAMES

Join an ever-growing global community of potential allies and enemies. Deploy your army, forge alliances, and fight in nail-biting, turn-based showdowns where the bold and the cunning rule. Every match is a tactical puzzle where only the strongest strategy will prevail. Challenge real players in online matches across over 120 unique maps, each offering its own wartime scenario - from ancient empires to reliving the greatest historical battles, multiple fantasy scenarios, modern skirmishes & interstellar conflict and galactic wars.

KEY FEATURES:

BUILD AND COMMAND YOUR ARMY

Draft reinforcements, place your troops and execute your plan of attack. Each turn is a strategic crossroads - will you defend, expand or hold the line? Your ability to manage your army and outmaneuver your opponents is what defines a true RISK tactician.

STRATEGIC DIPLOMACY & WARTIME ALLIANCES

In the world of RISK, a well-timed diplomatic offer can be as powerful as a cannon shot. Use clever diplomacy to build alliances, deceive your rivals, and turn temporary friends into stepping stones toward victory. Remember: in this wartime strategy game, trust is fragile, and betrayal is often the final move before triumph.

EXPLORE OVER 120 CLASSIC & ORIGINAL THEMED MAPS

Battle across an expansive selection of maps, from real-world terrains like Europe and Asia to ancient battlefields and outer space. Each battlefield introduces new pathways to victory that challenge you to employ different strategies, keeping every online match fresh and unpredictable. The classic map is 42 territories. Our custom maps range in size from ~20 territories for quick wars to advanced maps with 90+ territories for more drawn out battles.

EXPERIENCE THE TURN-BASED COMBAT OF THE ORIGINAL CLASSIC BOARD GAME

Enjoy the suspense and intensity of the traditional turn-based combat of the classic Hasbro board game. Your tactics must adapt each round as enemies close in, defenses falter, or opportunities arise. Each battle becomes a thrilling test of your long-term planning and decision-making skills.

SOLO & MULTIPLAYER GAME MODES

Play against AI in solo mode or face off with millions of players online or friends in pass & play. Climb the ranks, claim glory and prove your dominance by reaching the prestigious Grandmaster tier.

NEW WAYS TO PLAY THE CLASSIC BOARD GAME

Stay true to the classic board game rules or game modes that shake up the rules with exciting new twists like Blizzards, Portals, Fog of War, Zombies, Secret Assassin, and Secret Missions. Each mode adds fresh layers of strategy, making every match feel new and dynamic.

FREE TO DOWNLOAD AND PLAY

This game is NOT Pay to Win. All purchases unlock new maps or cosmetics. There is no power advantage to any player

CROSS PLATFORM PLAY & ACCOUNTS

Your account and any purchases carries across all our available platforms. We’ve had players who bought premium (for unlimited play) once several years ago and still enjoy the perks.

CONSTANTLY UPDATED

We’ve been updating the game for almost 10 years and not slowing down. New features, fixes and content is constantly going in to keep the game fresh and interesting to our millions of players.
Join the Fight. Rule the World.

Lead your armies, shape the battlefield, and leave your mark on the world stage. With every move, alliance, and turn, you write a new chapter in your legend. Prove you have the mind of a master tactician and download the official RISK: Global Domination today!.

Dashboard - Get a complete overview of your inventory management, right from sales to item quantity in a single place.

Warehouse management - Create and manage different warehouses or stores in the same app without worrying about losing track of the stock count. Restrict warehouse information to users across warehouses and branches using appropriate user restrictions.

Accounting - Manage your sales tax with ease and keep tabs on your accounting simultaneously as Zoho Inventory integrates with Zoho Books and QuickBooks Online to ease your financial needs.

name: Recipe Calculator
description:
The Kitchen Calculator app by MyKitchenCalculator.com is a tool that includes a recipe converter (recipe multiplier), cooking references, and several conversion calculators that help you easily convert between the most common measuring units used in cooking and baking.

The recipe converter tool allows you to scale, multiply, divide, or portion your recipes to the serving size you desire. Easily convert recipes to your desired serving size by typing in (*or copying and pasting*) the ingredients from your favorite online food blogs or recipe sites.

*Note: Due to the nature of text formatting, the copy and paste function may not work directly for some websites and certain mobile browsers.

The ingredient unit converter tool allows you to convert by ingredient between volume and weight units, such as cups and grams. Choose from more than 250 of the most common ingredients, such as butter, eggs, flour, and sugar!

The tool also includes basic conversion calculators for Volume, Weight, Length, Energy, Time, and Temperature. For most conversions, you can directly type in fractions as an input value, such as "1 1/2" or "3/4". The tool also keeps a history of your past conversions.

In addition to conversion calculators, the app has a Gas Mark reference and a cooking temperature references that allows you to quickly look up information about cooking temperatures for meat, candy, and other dishes.

Take the power of recipe conversion with you by downloading this app. MyKitchenCalculator.com, recipe conversion made easier!

Recipe Converter:
Multiply, divide, or portion recipes with ease. This tool will take fraction inputs and output them to the nearest fraction also!

Ingredient Unit Converter:
Convert by ingredient between common volume and weight units for more than 250 ingredients! Includes sticks of butter conversion and conversion of medium, large, and x-large whole eggs!

Volume Converter:
Convert between units of teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, pints, quarts, gallons, fluid ounces, milliliters, liters. You can also convert between US and UK (imperial) units. There is also a conversion to "Cups and Spoons". This conversion will convert volume units to denominations of common measuring cups and spoons. For example, 1.75 cups = 1 cup + 3/4 cup.

Weight Converter:
Convert between units of grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds. You can even convert to "Pounds and Ounces".

Length Converter:
Convert between units of millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. You can even convert to "Feet and Inches".

Energy Converter:
Convert between Joules, Kilojoules, Gram Calories, and Food Calories (Kilocalories)

Time Converter:
Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.

Temperature Converter:
Convert between units of Fahrenheit, Celsius, and Kelvin.

Gas Mark Reference:
View common gas mark settings in Fahrenheit or Celsius.

Cooking Temperatures:
Easily look up the USDA recommended cooking temperatures of most dishes such as meats, eggs, and casseroles. You can also look up candy cooking temperatures that tell you the stages of sugar at each temperature range.

Easily share your conversions with others if your device has compatible share action apps such as certain email or text messaging apps.

Notes:
1)Conversions are calculated approximations and may not be exact.
2)US volume conversions are NIST based rounded values.
3)Conversions by ingredients are based on USDA values and actual measured values.
4)Always check for proper conversions before using converted recipes.
5)This tool is based on rounded and simplified values and is not recommended for mathematical, engineering, or scientific calculations that need precision.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

name: KnowDrugs Drug Checking
description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

name: Loop Habit Tracker
description:
Loop helps you create and maintain good habits, allowing you to achieve your long-term goals. Detailed charts and statistics show you how your habits improved over time. The app is completely ad-free, open source and it respects your privacy.


Simple, beautiful and modern interface
Loop has a minimalistic interface that is very easy to use and follows the material design guidelines.

Habit score
In addition to showing your current streak, Loop has an advanced formula for calculating the strength of your habits. Every repetition makes your habit stronger, and every missed day makes it weaker. A few missed days after a long streak, however, will not completely destroy your entire progress, unlike other don't-break-the-chain apps.

Detailed graphs and statistics
Clearly see how your habits improved over time with detailed charts and statistics. Scroll back to see the complete history of your habits.

Flexible schedules
Supports not only daily habits, but also habits with more complex schedules, such as 3 times every week; one time every other week; or every other day.

Reminders
Create an individual reminder for each habit, at a chosen hour of the day. Easily check, dismiss or snooze your habit directly from the notification, without opening the app.

Widgets
Track your habits directly from your home screen, with beautiful and colorful widgets.

Completely ad-free and open source
There are absolutely no advertisements, annoying notifications or intrusive permissions in this app, and there will never be. The complete source code is available under an open-source license (GPLv3).

Works offline and respects your privacy
Loop doesn't require an Internet connection or online account registration. Your confidential habit data never leaves your phone. Neither the developers nor any third-parties have access to it.

Take your data with you
If you want to further analyze your data or move it to another service, Loop allows you to export it to spreadsheets (CSV) or to a database format (SQLite).

description:

» Fully Customisable

» Add Some Positive Habits
Want to go for a nice walk every day? Or maybe give 3 hugs every Saturday and Sunday? Join us on this journey!

» Who is it for?
Whether you want to read some more, stop smoking, start working out or even just track how many hours you wasted on Facebook, this app lets you do it!

» Features
•  Track multiple habits, repeated to do's or goals, each in its own calendar
•  Streak counter and percentage successful for each habit
•  Yes/No or Number goals
•  Very flexible goals like: number of times per day/week/month, only on certain days of the week etc. For example: 30 push ups every Mon-Fri, go to the gym 2 times per week, or even every 2 days
•  Inspiring quotes per category - including actual quotes from people doing it (meditation, reading, stop drinking alcohol, stop smoking cigarettes, stop procrastination etc)
•  Graphs with success percentage / streak, entered values etc
•  Powerful reminders - multiple times per day, repeating within a time period, sound and vibrate optional
•  Home screen / lock screen widget
•  Multi-device syncing
•  Cloud backup
•  Motivational images
•  Export to CSV
•  Dark theme
•  Google Fit integration

» How it works:
1. Set up a habit
2. Tell HabitBull how you went for a day
3. Watch your daily streak increase

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. This is especially useful if you have a to do list with repeating tasks or if you want to be reminded to do the same thing every day. It can also be used as a calendar planning tool or checklist, but also as a very effective repeating reminder (e.g. to drink water every 2 hours).

HabitBull does feel a little like a game in which you compete with yourself. The task is to get a long streak for the habit you are working on by covering your goals. The longer the better. It takes a couple of months to fully build a new routine, so don't give up - it takes time and if you are consistent it will work; even if it takes a few attempts.

There are many things which you may want to improve. HabitBull can be used as a planner in building habits like taking your pills regularly, exercise, or keep to a diet. It can also be used as a helper for people suffering from memory problems. As for your vices, HabitBull can be a useful goal tracking tool, or a smart notebook, to assist you while breaking bad habits like nail-biting, drinking alcohol and even improving your dating skills.
It is entirely up to you, really. But why not give it a try and have a convenient helper on the go?

name: Product Management - CraftUp
description:
CraftUp is the product management learning app for product managers, aspiring PMs, founders, designers and developers who want to build better products. It helps you learn product management step by step with short, focused daily lessons you can actually apply in your work and side projects.

If you want to start a product management career, move from junior to mid or senior product manager, or simply make smarter product decisions as a founder, CraftUp gives you a clear, structured path. You learn modern product management, not random tips or outdated theory.

CraftUp is built around real product work. Each lesson focuses on one concrete product management decision: understanding a user problem, validating an idea, designing an MVP, planning a simple experiment, running user interviews, defining product metrics, or deciding what to ship next. You do not just read about product management, you practice product thinking every day.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

With CraftUp you will learn core product management skills, including:

How to find real problems worth solving using user research

How to validate ideas with interviews, surveys and simple experiments

How to design and build MVPs that test the right product assumptions

How to get your first users and grow from zero with limited time and budget

How to use feedback, data and metrics to improve your product

How to understand product market fit and avoid false signals

How to prioritize a roadmap when everything feels important

How to make better product decisions with scarce resources

How to think and communicate like a product manager or founder

This is practical product management training you can use if you are preparing for a PM role, already working as a product manager, or building your own startup.

WHO CRAFTUP IS FOR

CraftUp is designed for:

People starting from zero who want a clear way to learn product management

Aspiring product managers preparing for their first PM job or interview

Junior product managers who want to grow faster and build confidence

Founders and indie hackers who need product management skills to ship smarter

Designers and developers who want to understand product decisions, not just tickets

Professionals in other fields who want to learn product thinking and turn ideas into products

HOW IT WORKS

CraftUp breaks product management into small, guided steps. Lessons are short, structured and focused on one topic at a time. You can complete a lesson in a few minutes, but over time you build deep understanding of how real product management works.

You learn how to frame user problems, write simple hypotheses, design experiments, pick metrics that matter, and make tradeoffs. Many lessons use examples from real products and real product managers so you see how product thinking works in practice, not in theory.

WHY CRAFTUP IS DIFFERENT

CraftUp is not another generic business course or a playlist of long video lectures. It is a dedicated product management learning environment. The content is focused only on product management and product thinking. No fluff, no motivational noise, just clear explanations and concrete actions.

The experience is calm and intentional. You will not find growth hacking tricks or pressure to hustle more. Instead, CraftUp helps you build a consistent learning habit so you actually stick with product management over weeks and months. You get just enough structure to keep moving forward without feeling overwhelmed.

CraftUp is your companion in the messy but rewarding process of learning product management and turning ideas into real products. Whether you want to become a product manager, level up in your current role, or build your own product as a founder, CraftUp gives you the product management skills, mindset and practice you need.

Learn product management. Build better products.

name: Noterly: simple reminders
description:
Noterly: the one-stop-shop for creating simple reminders and notes right in your notifications! Noterly allows you to schedule notifications to appear on your device whenever you like, to remind you to take out the bins, make your bed, and so much more!

⭐ To start, simply open the app and tap the create button. Simply add a title to your notification and you're done! If you want, you can add a body and colour to further distinguish your notifications.

✅ Done with a notification? Tap mark as done in the notification itself to archive it, or swipe it away in the app.

⌚ Want to schedule a notification to appear at a specific time? That's easy! Simple toggle the scheduled option to on, and choose a date and time that suits you!

🔁 How about showing a notification every day? Piece of cake! Toggle the repeating option to on, set a date and time for it to first appear, and then choose a duration on which the notification repeats. It can be entirely customised by you, whether it be every hour, every 6 hours, every 2 days, etc.

💡 Remember that repeating notifications will only repeat once they're marked as complete from the notification; so once you've been reminded, tap the button and it'll repeat when its next supposed to. Done with a repeating notification? Swipe it away in the app to archive it.

🤭 Accidentally dismissed a notification? No problem. Head to the archived page in the app, and you'll find a list of all your archived notifications. You can simply tap one and then reactivate it to show it once more. Or, if you're done with it, swipe it away to delete it forever.

Generate PDF or CSV reports of your full maintenance and repair history. Export your vehicle records anytime — perfect for insurance claims, resale documentation, or personal record-keeping.


MULTIPLE VEHICLE SUPPORT

- Car owners who want to stay on top of maintenance schedules

name: HVAC Airflow CFM Calculator
description:
HVAC Airflow CFM Calculator helps HVAC technicians, engineers, and contractors calculate cubic feet per minute (CFM) airflow with four methods for cross-checking and verification. This air conditioning calculator eliminates guesswork in ductwork design and system diagnostics.

CALCULATION METHODS:
Temperature Delta Method — CFM from BTU load and supply/return temperature difference
Duct Velocity Method — CFM from duct size (round or rectangular) and air velocity (FPM)
Sensible Heat Method — CFM from sensible cooling/heating capacity and temperature delta
Total Heat Method — CFM from total heat load and enthalpy difference

CORE FEATURES:
Round & Rectangular Duct Support — Both duct shapes in velocity calculations
Cross-Check Verification — Use multiple CFM methods to validate calculations
Instant Results — Airflow, velocity, and duct area displayed in real-time
100% Offline Operation — No internet connection required for field calculations

name: Allday HVAC Calc
description:
The application can be useful for HVAC engineers and contains 3 modules.

Psychrometric Calculator - this module determines air properties based on input values such as dry-bulb temperature, wet-bulb temperature, and relative humidity. It provides results like humidity ratio, specific volume, enthalpy, and vapor pressure in both SI and IP units.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. The module supports interdependent calculations of flow rate, heat load, and fluid temperatures: when any three of these parameters are specified, the fourth is calculated automatically. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. It can also be used as a reference material for determining the properties of wet and dry air at different pressures and temperatures.

Also in the description sections are the reference formulas by which the calculations are made.

description:

Llama Life let’s you set a countdown timer for *every* task. This concept is called ‘timeboxing’, and the idea is to create a (positive) constraint around the time we have to do something. name: Accu​Battery
description:
Accu​Battery displays battery usage information, and measures battery capacity (mAh) based on science.
 
❤ BATTERY HEALTH
 
Batteries have a limited lifespan. Every time you charge your device, it wears out the battery, lowering its total capacity.

- Use our charge alarm to remind you to unplug your charger.
- Discover how much battery wear was endured during your charge session.
 
📊 BATTERY USE
 
Accu​Battery measures the actual battery usage using information from the battery charge controller. Battery usage per app is determined by combining these measurements with information on which app is in the foreground. Android calculates battery usage using pre-baked profiles that device manufacturers provide, like how much power the CPU uses. In practice however, these numbers tend to be highly inaccurate.
 
- Monitor how much battery your device is using
- Know how long you can use your device when it’s active or in standby mode
- Find out how much power each app uses.
- Check how often your device gets woken up from deep sleep.
 
🔌 CHARGE SPEED
 
Use Accu​Battery to find the fastest charger and USB cable for your device. Measure the charging current (in mA) to find out!
 
- Check how fast your device is charging when the screen is on or off.
- Know how long it takes to charge your phone and when it’s finished.
 
HIGHLIGHTS
 
- Measure real battery capacity (in mAh).
- See how much wear your battery sustains with each charge session.
- Look up the discharge speed and battery consumption per app.
- Remaining charge time - know how long it takes before your battery is charged.
- Remaining use time - know when you will run out of battery.
- Screen on or screen off estimations.
- Check the percentage of deep sleep, when the device is in standby mode.
- Ongoing notification for real time battery statistics at a glance.
 
🏆 PRO FEATURES
 
- Use Dark and AMOLED black themes to save energy.
- Access to historical sessions older than 1 day.
- Detailed battery statistics in notification.
- No ads
 
We're a small, independent app developer with a focus on quality and passion for battery statistics. AccuBattery doesn’t require access to privacy-sensitive information and doesn't make false claims. If you like the way we work, support us by upgrading to the Pro version.

description:
AndroidInsight - System Monitor and Notification!

Have you ever wondered what is your CPU or GPU doing now, how much battery current is, what is battery's health, what are the temperatures of your CPU or GPU or Battery, how much memory is currently available and so on? Usually to do this you have to quit your app and switch to other app to see this data. But by the time of switching data is already irrelevant!

With help of this CPU/GPU/Battery Monitor & Notification you can have all this data as permanent notification and you can access it in a single swipe.

The app shows:

1. Name of app (or process) consuming most CPU cycles now*
2. CPU utilization - total, per core and per core type (E - efficient, H - high performance, P - prime)
3. CPU frequency - current, maximum and average
4. CPU active cores
5. CPU running cores
6. CPU temperature*
7. Battery temperature
8. Available memory
9. GPU utilization*
10. GPU frequency - current and maximum*
11. Battery charge/discharge rate

AND ALL THAT SIMULTANEOUSLY AS NOTIFICATION!

Additional app's features:

1. Monitor battery remaining capacity.
2. Monitor how fast your battery changes/discharges.
3. Charge alarm (it can be used to notify when battery charge reaches certain level).
4. Customize what data is visible in the notification(s).
5. Battery overheat alarm.
6. Customize app's theme.
7. Show information about device's hardware.*

Supports Android 16

The application is crafted by team based in Europe which pays attention to the hardware details. We are curious about what exactly the hardware is doing at every moment in order to utilize it more efficiently. It was initially created for personal use but later decided that it could be useful for everybody.

As the application grows we developed a dark theme for it. It was also inspired by other utility application that our team built with love - https://nighteye.app

* DISCLAIMER: GPUs are rarely supported on latest Android versions. This is because of permission issues. Also because of permissions issues with some custom ROMs (like Linage OS) other options marked with * may not be supported as well. Sorry for this inconvenient. If there is someway to solve it, we will. Data shown in the application is for information only. For accurate specification please refer to the manufacturer.

If you wish other functionality in the app, feel free to write an email to our support team!

Thanks!

name: Introvert - Be Social
description:
Embracing your inner extrovert might feel like stepping into uncharted territory, but fear not! Becoming more social is an exciting journey that begins with simple steps, gradually leading to newfound confidence and sociability.

Start by taking baby steps into the world of social interactions. Begin with small talk; strike up a conversation with a friendly neighbor, a co-worker, or someone waiting in line. Practice active listening - it's an art that helps you connect more deeply with others.

Challenge yourself to attend social gatherings or events. It might feel daunting at first, but remember, each experience is a chance to grow. Push your comfort zone a little each time. Maybe set a goal to attend one social event a week, or even a month, to start with.

Join clubs or groups that align with your interests. Whether it's a book club, a hiking group, or a cooking class, being around like-minded individuals can make socializing feel more natural and enjoyable.

Practice positive self-talk. Encourage yourself along the way. Acknowledge your progress and celebrate the little victories. Remember, Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither is the confident extrovert version of yourself!

Lastly, be patient and kind to yourself. Transforming into a more social butterfly takes time. Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither will your social prowess. Each step you take, no matter how small, is a stride toward a more confident and outgoing you.

So, get ready to spread your wings and dive into the wonderful world of social interactions. You've got this!

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

Most people wake up exhausted even after 8 hours of sleep. They crash at 2pm. They're drained by Friday. The reason isn't usually sleep duration — it's recovery quality, nervous system stress, hidden lifestyle drains, and the patterns no one's tracking for them.

Sleep apps measure sleep. Step counters measure movement. Energio measures the thing nobody else does: your actual energy — and the specific reasons it's low.

- AI Pattern Detection — Spot what's draining you across days, weeks, months.
- Personalized Actions — Specific suggestions tied to your data, not generic advice.
- Progress Tracking — See what changed when you fixed something.

✨ What Makes Energio Different

Energio is built for one thing: solving chronic tiredness and fatigue. Not steps. Not sleep duration. Not workout recovery for athletes. Just the question millions of people search every night — why am I so tired? — answered with their own data.

- Phone-only. No €300 ring or watch required.
- Diagnostic, not prescriptive — finds the cause, doesn't lecture.
- Built for tired people, not biohackers.
- AI maps patterns across HRV, sleep, lifestyle, and self-reports.
- Action-oriented — every insight comes with a fix to test.

🔍 What Energio Can Help You Spot

- How alcohol the night before drops your HRV the next day
- How late-night screens silently delay your recovery
- How a week without sunlight crashes your energy by Friday
- How stress accumulates before you consciously feel it
- Which lifestyle factors give you energy — and which steal it

👤 Who Energio Is For

People who are tired for no clear reason. Burned-out professionals. Remote workers stuck in afternoon slumps. Students, freelancers, creators running on fumes. Anyone recovering from burnout, post-viral fatigue, or chronic tiredness. Anyone who's tried sleeping more and felt no different.

You're not lazy. You're not broken. You're tired — and there's usually a reason.
Energio finds the why. You get the how.

📲 Download Energio and stop guessing why you feel drained.

name: Allervibe: Food Allergy Scan
description:
Stop guessing in the grocery aisle.

You're standing in front of a shelf, package in hand. The label is in 6-point font. The "may contain" warning is hiding somewhere between the additives and the nutrition table. Your kid has a peanut allergy. You squint. You flip the box. You put it back. You move on.

Allervibe was built for that moment.

Point your camera at the barcode. In about a second, you have your answer: green to eat, yellow for caution, red to avoid. No squinting. No second-guessing. No anxiety in aisle four.

Here is the whole loop:

1. Tell Allervibe once which allergens you avoid, with how strict you are about each.
2. Scan a barcode.
3. We read the ingredients, the allergen declarations, and the trace warnings, then match them against your profile.
4. You get a clear verdict, plus the full ingredient list and a breakdown of every additive used.

That is it. No account. No sync. No waiting.

Allervibe covers the 13 most common food allergens: peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, soy, wheat, gluten, sesame, shellfish, fish, sulphites, mustard, and celery. Behind the scenes we use Open Food Facts, the world's largest open database of food products, with millions of entries from over 100 countries. Coverage in your local supermarket gets better every week.

Built for:

• Parents reading every label twice for their kids
• Anyone with celiac disease, gluten intolerance, or a wheat allergy
• People managing lactose intolerance or dairy sensitivities
• Adults with nut, peanut, sesame, or shellfish allergies
• Households balancing multiple dietary needs in one shopping trip
• Vegans and vegetarians spotting hidden animal ingredients
• Travellers reading labels in foreign supermarkets

Allervibe is free to use, every day. The free version covers daily scans, your personal allergen profile, and full detection across all 13 allergens. No ads. Ever.

Allervibe Pro unlocks:

• Unlimited daily scans
• Your full scan history with search
• Favorites for products you have already cleared
• Family profiles, so each person in the household has their own allergen list
• A detailed additives breakdown with E-numbers and common names

A profile for every member of your family? That was the whole point. One person is celiac. Another is dairy-free. A third reacts to nuts. With family profiles in Allervibe Pro you switch between them with a tap before you scan, and everyone gets the answer that matters to them.

Allervibe lives on your device. Your allergen profiles, your scan history, and your favorites stay private. We do not sell your data. We do not share what you scan. We do not require an account or a sign-in.

Currently available in English and German, with French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, and Russian on the way.

A note on safety. Allervibe is an informational tool, not a medical device. Always read the packaging before you eat. If you have a severe or life-threatening allergy, do not rely on the app alone. Read the label, follow your doctor's guidance, and carry your prescribed medication. Data accuracy depends on Open Food Facts, which is community-edited and may be incomplete.

name: Allergy Food Alert
description:
Allergy Food Alert helps you shop with food allergies or intolerances in mind. Scan a barcode to load Open Food Facts data, or photograph an ingredient list on the pack to read the text on your device and check it against your personal allergen profile—including severity and alerts you choose.

Features
• Barcode scanning — Use the camera to load product data from Open Food Facts.
• Ingredient photos — Capture a clear photo of the ingredient list on the packaging; on-device text recognition (Google ML Kit) extracts the text, which is then checked with the same keyword logic as ingredient text from the database. Recognition works best with Latin script; other scripts may not read reliably—always verify the physical label.
• Personal allergen profile — Pick allergens to track and set severity (mild to critical), with alerts where you need them.
• Clear safety signals — See whether a product is high risk, needs caution, or shows no strong match for your profile, using declared allergens, traces, and ingredient text when available.
• Ingredients & allergen text — View declared allergens, “may contain” / traces, and ingredient lists from the database.
• On-device translation — Choose how to show ingredients: match your device language with automatic translation (Google ML Kit on device), or show the original text from Open Food Facts.
• Saved scans — Save products with custom names; open, review, or delete them later.
• Settings — Update your allergen profile and ingredient language anytime.
• Contribute — Jump to Open Food Facts to improve data (photos, structured allergens, details).

Important — Allergy Food Alert relies on open community data and on-device recognition; neither is guaranteed complete or accurate. Photo and text recognition can misread words or miss lines. It is not medical or legal advice. Manufacturers can change recipes before databases update. Always read the physical product label before you buy or eat—especially if your allergy is severe.

name: Open Food Facts
description:
🔍 Scan, Discover & Compare Over 4 Million Food Products


The app allows to scan the 4 million products already contained in the free and open database Open Food Facts.
The app is collaborative. If we don't have the product, you can add pictures and data to get the Nutri-Score and NOVA score on food processing.

In short, we're kind of "the Wikipedia of food", as many have nicknamed the project. Open Food Facts has enabled the creation of over 100 apps like Date Limite, Yuka or FoodVisor.

🥦 Make Healthier Food Choices



➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality
➜ The NOVA group, from 1 to 4 : Avoid ultra-processed foods (Group 4)

🌍 Join Our Mission for Food Transparency



➜ Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.
➜ You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose.
➜ You can start contributing today by adding a product from your fridge.
➜ Open Food Facts is a non-profit project developed by thousands of volunteers from around the world. We have lots of exciting projects you can contribute to in many different ways.

🏷️ Decode Food Labels with Ease



➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

🚨 Set Allergen Alerts


➜ Milk, Gluten, Eggs, Soybeans, Nuts, Fish, Celery, Mustard, Sulphur dioxide and sulphites, Peanuts, Sesame seeds, Crustaceans, Molluscs or Lupin allergy ?
➜ Speed up your shopping by doing an initial screening of your food with Open Food Facts.
➜ Be careful that the information may not be 100% accurate, and detection may not be 100% accurate. So always double check by yourself, with the packaging.

💰 Open Prices: Transparency on Food Costs


- Contribute to Price Transparency. When you shop, add the price on the shelf, or at home, add the receipt. Let's track shrinkflation, cheapflation & more.

💄🧴🐶 More Than Just Food: Scan All Your Products


Open Beauty Facts: Scan cosmetics and hygiene products. You can check for ingredients you want to avoid by setting up "ingredient bans" to get personalized alerts.

Open Pet Food Facts: Find information on food for your furry friends.

Open Products Facts: Discover information on all other products (e.g., electronics, toys, clothes). This database helps you make more circular choices and increase the life of your products.

name: FODMAP Scanner: IBS Diet
description:
Stop guessing. Start scanning and cooking.

Living with IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome), SIBO, Crohn's disease, or a food intolerance makes every meal a decision. Is that sauce safe? Are there hidden triggers in that ingredient list? What can you actually cook tonight without triggering bloating or stomach pain?

FODMAP Scanner answers those questions in seconds — with AI.

WHAT IS IT?

FODMAP Scanner is your complete "Grocery to Kitchen" companion for the Low FODMAP elimination diet. Scan barcodes at the store, analyze ingredient labels with your camera, search thousands of Low FODMAP recipes, and build your personal list of safe foods — all in one app.

Whether you are newly diagnosed with IBS or a seasoned Low FODMAP veteran, this is the one tool that follows you from the grocery aisle to the dinner table.

KEY FEATURES:

• AI Barcode & Ingredient Scanner Point your camera at any barcode or physical ingredient list. Our AI instantly detects hidden IBS triggers — like onion powder, garlic, high-fructose corn syrup, chicory root fiber, and excess lactose — so you never get caught off guard at the store.

• Low FODMAP Recipe Database Stop reverse-engineering normal recipes. Search thousands of strictly Low FODMAP recipes for quick dinners, easy meal preps, and safe snacks — without the mental math.

• Instant Low / High Verdict Every food gets a clear, science-backed result:

LOW — Safe for a Low FODMAP diet.

MODERATE — Safe in specific serving sizes. We give you the exact amounts to avoid symptom stacking.

HIGH — Likely to trigger IBS symptoms, bloating, or digestive discomfort.

• Deep Ingredient Analysis We show you exactly why a food is safe or not — naming the specific FODMAP types (fructans, GOS, lactose, excess fructose, polyols) and which ingredients are the culprits. You actually learn to read labels on your own.

• Personal Safe Food Lists Save your go-to safe products and organize them into custom lists. Your scanned photos are analyzed securely and never permanently stored.

• Product Database Search Can't find your product by barcode? Search our database directly to look up ingredients and FODMAP content for thousands of branded foods.

PERFECT FOR:

• IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome) management • SIBO (Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth) diet support • Crohn's disease and digestive condition management • The Low FODMAP elimination and reintroduction phases • Food intolerance and sensitivity identification • Finding fast bloating and gas relief through safe eating • Identifying Gluten-Free and Dairy-Free options easily • Building a personalized gut health meal plan

WHO USES IT?

People newly diagnosed with IBS who are starting the elimination phase, experienced FODMAP dieters who want a faster way to check products at the store, and anyone managing a chronic digestive condition who is tired of second-guessing every meal.

Take control of your gut health today. FODMAP Scanner is the daily companion that turns grocery shopping and cooking from a source of anxiety into something you can feel genuinely confident about.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER: FODMAP Scanner is an informational tool that provides data on FODMAP content. It does not create custom diets and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your physician, gastroenterologist, or registered dietitian before making dietary changes.

name: Gluten Dude: GF Restaurants
description:
If you live gluten-free (especially with celiac disease), you know the drill: eating out takes research, travel takes planning, and “GF-friendly” usually tells you nothing.

Gluten Dude helps you find gluten-free restaurants, read kitchen notes regarding cross-contact procedures, plan trips (driving + airports), and save money with gluten-free deals.

WHAT MAKES GLUTEN DUDE DIFFERENT
Most apps give you a giant list and call it a day. We don’t. Every listing is recommended, researched, and categorized so you can choose what feels right for you.

Filter restaurants by type:
• 100% Gluten-Free (dedicated gluten-free kitchens)
• Dude Vetted (recommended + researched, plus direct vetting notes from the kitchen)
• User Suggested (recommended + researched when the restaurant doesn’t respond)
• Chains (chains the community consistently rates highly)

Read notes from the kitchen:
For Dude Vetted places, you’ll see a “Dude Vetting Note” that tells you what matters: prep practices, shared equipment, and the real-world details you wish every restaurant would explain upfront.

Travel tools that actually help:
• Driving Trip Planner: find food along your route
• Custom filters: distance from route, restaurant type, cuisine
• Flying support: airport options by terminal (plus destination planning)

Save money living gluten-free:
Access exclusuive coupons, brand discounts, and online savings across a huge list of gluten-free products.

Updated constantly:
New restaurants, new deals, and new tools — without turning the app into a confusing mess.

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING

"Your approach is far superior to other apps in terms of safety. Your app is desperately needed." - Sandy

"Thank you for being an instrumental part of the celiac community. I trust your app so much more than any other." – Erica

"Nothing else I’ve seen has the breadth of up-to-date, peace-of-mind info on where to safely go." – GF Seeker

"I feel much more confident & safer using your app vs. any other. How diligent you are is what separates you from the rest." – Laura

"I won’t use any other app besides yours - because safety first!" - Kelly

ABOUT ME

I'm Scott, aka Gluten Dude. I was diagnosed with celiac in 2007 and started blogging in 2011 to help others navigate the same overwhelming path. For over 15 years, I’ve been advocating for this community, calling out the BS, raising awareness, and pushing for better support.

Five years ago, I launched this app to take that mission even further, giving you tools to travel, dine, and live gluten-free with more confidence and less stress. Now in 2026 I've rebuilt it to serve the gluten-free community even better.

Kind words from the Gluten-Free Community...

"Thank you for your answers, wisdom, support and humor. I could not live this life without you." - Susan

"Your knowledge and honesty is like a life raft in an unknown and terrifying ocean." - Jess

"Keep rockin’ Gluten Dude. You are changing the world for us." - Laura

"I appreciate all you try to do for all of us in the celiac community. Your ongoing and relentless support is such a gift. Thank YOU." - Hillary

Download the Gluten Dude app and take the guesswork out of gluten-free living.

Eat well. Travel smart. Save money.

description:

Eat Smart Kiwi helps you discover the effect of your eating on acne, bloating, stomach pain, headaches, energy levels, mood, or anything else you want to track. You will also get information on your typical nutrient intake if desired.

🍏 Log meals and body cues in seconds
